title: Kie Senpai releases the single “ High Off Life”
htmlContent:
Kie Senpai is a multi-talented singer and songwriter who enjoys music and creation. The talented artist recently released an incredible single titled “High Off Life.” A must hear sound with a Brazilian funk beat with a rap that smacks.

Kie Senpai’s “High Off Life” is an instant classic that one play won’t be enough for you. In a time when music can be generic, he brings an authentic musical experience that is refreshing to hear and great music to get lost in. It excels in every category of record making, from the super smooth production, excellent writing you can feel, and a vocal performance that melts you with every note.
